{{Quote|Inbound vessel, this is the Imperial Warship ''Eye of the Storm''. Identify yourself.|The ''Eye of the Storm'' hails a starship|<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref>}}
The '''''Eye of the Storm''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warship stationed over the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. It carried a complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and worked in concert with an [[Imperial launch]]. The ''Eye of the Storm'' was present when a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Skirmish on Tazan|traveled]] to the planet in order to destroy the planet's [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]]. A team of five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] boarded the Rebel vessel.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"[[Ultimate Core Dump]]" does not indicate what class the ''Eye of the Storm'' is, describing it as as an "Imperial Warship" and an "Imperial cruiser." It was large enough to have a hangar bay capable of holding a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. As the vessel appears in a role-playing adventure, it is not clear whether its stormtroopers arrested the player characters aboard their ship, or whether they made it to the planet's surface unhindered.
